page_title: EVE 1-1 WHU | Everton v West Ham 29/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Andrew Irving (West Ham).
90+4' That's the end of the game for Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), who is replaced by Igor.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) will miss the next game.
90' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' James Garner (Everton) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alphonse Areola gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
90' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
89' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Everton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
88' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
88' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
87' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
86' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
84' The attendance is 51890.
83' James Garner (Everton) takes the direct free kick, but drags his shot well wide of the left post.
82' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
81' David Moyes has decided to substitute Iliman Ndiaye and he is replaced by Tyler Dibling (Everton).
80' The ball rebounds to El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
77' Today's match ends for Crysencio Summerville who will be replaced by Luis Guilherme (West Ham).
76' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

75' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box. Now West Ham have a corner.

73' The corner lands on the head of Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
73' The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

72' Great save! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jordan Pickford. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
69' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Beto (Everton) is replaced by Thierno Barry.
67' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
65' A cross from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
64' Max Kilman (West Ham) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
64' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

63' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jordan Pickford with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
63' Beto (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
61' The referee blows his whistle as Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
59' Substitution. Freddie Potts (West Ham) in, Soungoutou Magassa out.
59' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

58' James Garner (Everton) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Alphonse Areola denies him.
58' The resulting corner from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
56' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
56' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
52' Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
52' James Garner (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
50' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
49' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

49' Jake O'Brien (Everton) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' An attempted cross from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' West Ham continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
45' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. That's a free kick to West Ham.
42' 51:49 – the latest ball possession ratio.
40' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' West Ham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

37' So close! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
36' A clumsy foul by Jake O'Brien (Everton) and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle. West Ham have a free kick.
36' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

35' What an opportunity! Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
33' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton).
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Everton, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Referee Samuel Barrott sees the trip by Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Everton earn a free kick.

27' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Jordan Pickford didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
25' Samuel Barrott couldn't ignore the rough tackle by James Tarkowski (Everton) and blew his whistle.
24' It must be a yellow card. It is. James Tarkowski (Everton) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
24' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
21' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle. Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! James Garner clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Michael Keane (Everton), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the top of the net. Alphonse Areola had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
18' James Garner (Everton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
17' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.

16' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
15' Beto (Everton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is prepared and thwarts him.
14' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
13' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
10' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
9' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
5' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Beto (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half has started.
